text.text_excerpt: I was weary of staying anywhere in the Quarter (with family) so I chose French Market Inn for one night. It was above and beyond everything I expected. It was one of the best hotel stays I've ever had in fact. This is based on location, value and atmosphere/service. It is about three block walk from the actual French Market. You can wake up in the morning and stroll through Jackson Square over to Cafe Du Monde and come back up on the Mississippi side. Walk up St. Peter to two FABULOUS places to eat Pierre Maspero's and Napoleon House. And Bourbon is another block up. We had such a quiet, peaceful sleep as well as relaxing in the courtyard which has it's own picturesque scenery. There's ab...

I had a great time here! The first time I visited New Orleans, I opted to stay at an Airbnb. It was cool, but was a bus ride away from the French Quarter, do we wouldn't stay out as late. This time, we opted to stay at a hotel in the French Quarter aka French Market Inn! The location is great amd convenient; I wish I stayed here the last time because we came for the Oyster Fest, and it was literally walking distance to the venue! Also, it's nice here because it isn't overcrowded and noisy by the many tourists on Bourbon. Staff is soooooo friendly and sweet. Customer service is amazing and the hotel itself is beautiful! I wish I saw the famous Courtyard Cat. Nonetheless, it was a great time!

I stayed here over Labor Day weekend with some friends. Between us we rented three rooms at the French Market in. Located right on Decatur Street about 2 blocks from Bourbon and right by the river and Park this was a great location and an absolutely adorable Hotel. I would recommend it. It's also an easy less than two block walk to Cafe Du Monde. The staff were all super friendly and helpful. They even sent up a complimentary bottle of champagne to my room since it was my birthday weekend. They also made some accommodations that are members of our party could have rooms closer together.
